translations.web: Then Hezekiah the king arose early, gathered the princes of the city, and went up to Yahweh’s house.
translations.bsb: Early the next morning King Hezekiah gathered the city officials and went up to the house of the LORD.
translations.kjv: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD.
translations.asv: Then Hezekiah the king arose early, and gathered the princes of the city, and went up to the house of Jehovah.
